title: On the Mathematical Structure of Helical Shear in Anelastic Continua
summary: We study helical shear of a thick-walled tube made of an incompressible, isotropic hyper-anelastic solid carrying a radially symmetric distribution of axial screw dislocations. Through the Bilby--Kröner--Lee decomposition, the dislocations are encoded in a Weitzenböck material manifold, whose Riemannian metric alone enters the elastic response. Equilibrium reduces at each radius to an algebraic system for the azimuthal and axial shear strains, whose cross terms are proportional to the dislocation strength and to the dependence of the strain energy on the second invariant; the two shear modes…
